edibles.heading: Edibles
paragraphs: Jane Finch Cannabis is at 2728 Jane Street in North York, in the Jane and Finch area used by people coming from Finch West, Pioneer Village, and the York University corridor. The store is open 24 hours. This page is for packaged edibles, not for campus shopping and not for an on-campus outlet.

Edibles are cannabis products meant to be eaten or drunk from a sealed retail pack. Labels list flavour, format, and milligram details. That is a different category from dried flower or a vape: you compare pack names and printed details on the current menu rather than looking at loose flower.

The live menu is the working list. Posted prices can change, and a pack that was listed last week may not be on the shelf today. If you are making the trip for one specific edible, call 437-524-9336 first.
Walk in at 2728 Jane St. You do not need an appointment. Bring valid photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Staff can help you read the edible listings against what is actually available that visit.
If you are arriving with someone from campus or from Finch West, only adults 19+ should plan to come inside. Use the edible page to prepare, then confirm the labelled packs at the counter.
The store is a neighbourhood shop on Jane Street. It is not part of York University.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes
paragraphs: Jane Finch Cannabis sits at 2728 Jane St in North York, a Jane and Finch address for adults coming from Finch West, Pioneer Village, and the streets around York University. Hours are 24 hours. THC vapes are the portable vapour category on this menu.

A THC vape is a sealed cannabis vapour product sold by brand, listed potency, and pack details. Hardware styles vary by what is posted that day. Do not assume a particular cartridge or disposable format is in the case unless the live menu shows it. Check the live menu for current formats before you travel.
Posted prices can change. The menu page is the reference, not a screenshot from another day. Call 437-524-9336 if you need one listed vape confirmed before you leave home.
Walk in at 2728 Jane Street whenever the timing works. No appointment. Bring government-issued photo ID. Ask for the vape section and compare the labelled items on the counter.

If you are still deciding between categories, keep flower, edibles, and vapes on separate lists. A vape listing is not a flower tier and it is not an edible pack. Read the live menu line for the item in your hand.
This is an off-campus retail store on Jane Street. It is not affiliated with York University.
Use the current Jane Finch menu again before leaving Finch West or Pioneer Village.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates
paragraphs: Jane Finch Cannabis is the 24-hour shop at 2728 Jane Street in North York, used by people in Jane and Finch, Finch West, and the Pioneer Village side of the corridor. Concentrates are the extract aisle: small, labelled cannabis extracts rather than flower or edibles.

Concentrates are sold as packaged extracts. Each listing usually includes the product name, extract type, listed potency, and weight. That is a different shopping job than choosing a flower tier. Read the current labels. Do not assume an extract style will be waiting unless the live menu still shows it.
Menu names and posted prices change. Use the live menu, then confirm in the store. If one concentrate is the whole reason for the visit, call 437-524-9336 ahead of time.
Walk in at 2728 Jane St any hour. Bring ID. Adults 19 and older only. Staff can open the concentrate section and help you match listed items to what you came for.

If you came from Pioneer Village or Finch West with a short list, keep that list to the names on the Jane Finch menu. Another store’s extract names do not carry over. Confirm the labelled pack in front of you before you pay.
The address is on Jane Street in North York, not on the York University campus.
Review the current listing again before making the trip from Finch West.

vapes.heading: Nic Vapes
paragraphs: Jane Finch Cannabis is at 2728 Jane Street in North York, in the Jane and Finch area used by people from Finch West and Pioneer Village. The store is open 24 hours. Nic vapes are the nicotine vapour products on this menu, not the THC vape listings.

Nic vapes are sealed nicotine vapour items sold by brand, flavour notes, and pack details. Formats vary. Check the live menu for current formats before you travel. Do not assume a device style is waiting unless that page still shows it.
Posted prices can change. Call 437-524-9336 if one nic vape listing is the reason for the trip. The store is off campus and is not affiliated with York University.
Walk in at 2728 Jane St. No appointment. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask for the nic vape section and read the labels against the live menu.
If someone is coming with you from the York University area, only adults 19+ should plan to enter. Keep nic vapes and THC vapes on two lists so the counter visit stays clear.
If you only have a few minutes on Jane Street, write down two listed nic vape names from the live menu and ask for those first. If a format is not on the page, do not expect it in the case.
The address is 2728 Jane Street, North York.

flowerTiers.heading: Flower Tiers
paragraphs: Jane Finch Cannabis is the 24-hour shop at 2728 Jane St in North York, a Jane and Finch stop for Finch West, Pioneer Village, and the streets around York University. Flower tiers are the dried-cannabis groups on the live menu.

Flower is dried cannabis sold by name, listed weight, and posted price. Each tier page is a group of those listings. That is a different path from choosing an edible pack or a vape. Scan the tier that matches what you want to compare, then confirm the same names in the store.
Posted prices can change. A tier heading is not a promise that every name will still be on the shelf. Call 437-524-9336 if one listed jar is the reason you are heading down Jane Street.
Walk in at 2728 Jane Street any hour. Bring ID. Adults 19 and older only. Staff can open the tier you already reviewed and help you match labelled jars to the current page.
This is a neighbourhood retail store on Jane Street. It is not part of York University.
If you arrived from Pioneer Village with a short list, keep that list to names on the Jane Finch tier pages. Another store’s flower names do not carry over. Confirm the labelled jar before you pay.
Finch West and Jane and Finch are the area names. 2728 Jane St is the store.
